Title: AI Framework Engineer
Description: Job Details Job Description: The Role and Impact Join Intel's PyTorch and AI Frameworks Ecosystem team in Guadalajara, Mexico as an AI Framework Engineer and help enable and optimize AI workloads using the PyTorch framework for current and next-generation Intel Xeon platforms. In this role, you will work on AI framework and performance engineering projects spanning model enablement, framework optimization, debugging, performance analysis, and hardware-software integration. You will contribute to PyTorch and its ecosystem, collaborate with Intel architecture and performance teams, and work with the open-source community to improve functionality, performance, and out-of-box experience on Intel platforms. Your work will directly contribute to improving the performance and readiness of AI workloads on Intel Xeon processors and help deliver optimized AI solutions for developers and customers. Business Group As part of the Data Center Group (DCG), the PyTorch and AI Frameworks Ecosystem team focuses on enabling, developing and optimizing software solutions for artificial intelligence applications on Intel platforms. The team works across AI frameworks, libraries, models, and system software to enable new hardware capabilities, optimize workload performance, and contribute improvements to the open-source AI ecosystem. Through close collaboration with architecture, performance, validation, and open-source engineering teams, the organization supports Intel's broader mission to advance high-performance computing and AI solutions for the data center. Responsibilities Will Include But Are Not Limited To Enable, profile, debug, and optimize PyTorch AI workloads and models running on Intel Xeon server platforms. Develop and contribute enhancements to PyTorch and ecosystem libraries, improving functionality, performance, and out-of-box experience on Intel hardware. Analyze AI workload performance using profiling and benchmarking tools to identify software, framework, and kernel-level bottlenecks. Optimize AI model execution through improvements in framework code, operators, kernels, data types, memory usage, and execution flows. Enable AI workloads to take advantage of current and emerging Intel Xeon hardware capabilities. Contribute to the open-source PyTorch ecosystem through GitHub issues, code reviews, pull requests, technical discussions, and upstream contributions. Develop high-quality, maintainable Python and/or C++ software following modern software engineering and Git development practices. Leverage AI-assisted and agentic software development tools, such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, to accelerate development, debugging, code analysis, and engineering workflows. Document technical findings, performance investigations, design decisions, and solutions, and contribute to team knowledge sharing. Interact across engineering teams based in other locations. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications, you must possess the minimum qualifications below to be initially considered for this position. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or STEM-related field. 3+ years of experience in: Python and C++ programming languages. PyTorch Framework. Machine learning and deep learning concepts, algorithms, and methodologies. 18+ months of experience in: Git and collaborative software development practices. AI-assisted software development tools, including agentic AI solutions (such as Github Copilot, Claude Code). Linux development environment as user. AI model development, enablement, profiling or performance optimization. Advanced English level Must have unrestricted, permanent right to work in Mexico (this role is not eligible for visa or immigration sponsorship). Preferred Qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field. Experience with AI workload optimization and performance tuning, particularly for inference workloads. Knowledge of software debugging, profiling, and performance analysis techniques. Experience with PyTorch internals, operators, dispatching, compilation, or backend integration. Understanding of CPU architecture and hardware-software interactions, including vectorization, memory hierarchy, threading, and parallel execution. Background in performance profiling, memory optimization, throughput improvement, or latency reduction. Strong analytical understanding to solve complex software challenges. Background in AI framework internals, model execution, or backend integration. Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of relevant industry job experience, internship experience, and/or schoolwork/classes/research. We invite you to bring your passion for innovation and software engineering to Intel, where your skills will contribute to groundbreaking technology solutions. Apply today to join us in shaping the future of computing and driving the next wave of industry transformation. Shift Shift 1 (Mexico) Primary Location: Mexico, Guadalajara Additional Locations: Posting Statement All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. Title: Data Engineer - Mexico
Description: Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all. Who You’ll Work With At Slalom, we co-create custom software, data, AI, and cloud solutions with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We are passionate about technology and its potential to create better products, experiences, and organizations. Our Data Architecture & Engineering team sees data as the foundation for decision-making, artificial intelligence, and transformation. You may work with cross-platform data engineering teams or with one of our centers of excellence that specializes in a particular ecosystem. Slalom works across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Databricks, and Snowflake, along with the technologies that support each platform. Expertise across every platform is not required. Your current skills, delivery experience, and areas of interest will help determine which team and client opportunities are the best fit, while giving you room to expand your capabilities over time. What You’ll Do As a Data Engineer at Slalom, you will collaborate with clients, architects, and multidisciplinary delivery teams to design, build, and operationalize scalable data solutions. Your work may include: Designing and implementing cloud-native data platforms, data lakes, lakehouses , warehouses, and data products. Building reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, integrations, and orchestration workflows. Translating business and technical requirements into maintainable engineering solutions and actionable development tasks. Developing solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake ecosystems based on client needs and your areas of expertise. Applying software engineering practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, documentation, and secure development. Using AI-enabled engineering approaches and tools to improve delivery speed, quality, testing, documentation, and maintainability, with appropriate human review and responsible use. Designing, building, and operationalizing governed data platforms that support analytics, AI, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic workloads. Enabling data quality, metadata, lineage, security, privacy, governance, performance, reliability, and cost-effective operations. Participating in technical discovery, design sessions, code reviews, demonstrations, and knowledge sharing with clients and colleagues. Contributing to reusable patterns, accelerators, and engineering communities within Slalom. What You’ll Bring We welcome candidates with different combinations of experience. You do not need every skill listed below to be successful in this role. We are interested in the depth of your experience, your learning mindset, and the areas where you want to grow. Hands-on experience designing, building, testing, deploying, or supporting production data engineering solutions. Experience with at least one major cloud or data platform, such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, or Snowflake. Experience across multiple platforms is valued but not required. Proficiency in programming languages such as SQL, Python, Java and or Scala. Experience with several modern data engineering capabilities, such as data modeling, ETL/ELT, distributed processing, lakehouse architectures, streaming, APIs, orchestration, or data platform modernization. Familiarity with relevant technologies, which may include Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt , Dagster , Azure Data Factory, BigQuery , Redshift, Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Dataplex , Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Kinesis, Kubernetes, Terraform, or comparable tools. Understanding of how high-quality, secure, governed, and observable data foundations support AI, ML, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic solutions. Experience with AI-enabled or agentic engineering practices, including using AI-assisted development tools and designing data workflows or platforms that can support intelligent agents and automated decision workflows. A commitment to responsible engineering, including privacy, security, transparency, testing, monitoring, and appropriate human oversight for AI-enabled solutions. Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with an ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences. A curious, growth-oriented mindset and willingness to learn new platforms, tools, and delivery approaches. Additional Experience That May Be Helpful Cloud, Databricks, or Snowflake certifications. Experience in consulting or in client-facing, cross-functional delivery teams. Experience with MLOps , LLMOps , vector databases, model or prompt monitoring, feature stores, semantic layers, or AI platform operations. Experience modernizing legacy data environments or migrating workloads to cloud platforms. Experience mentoring others or contributing to technical communities and reusable assets. About Us Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. Hybrid/In office: We are hybrid and require that you live within a commutable distance to a Slalom location.  If your team leader or client requires you to be onsite, there are expectations that you can meet those requirements.

Evaluar la efectividad de eventos promocionales y generar insights accionables para optimizar futuras inversiones comerciales. Title: Coordinador de Riesgos Financieros
Description: ¡Sé parte del futuro de BradesCard! ¿Estás en búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento? Esta es tu oportunidad para destacar y crecer en una empresa con más de 10 años de exito en México. En BradesCard , buscamos un Coordinador de Riesgos Financieros quien sera el encargado de coordinar la operación de la UAIR mediante la gestión integral de riesgos financieros, a través de su identificación, medición, monitoreo, control y reporte de los riesgos de crédito, liquidez y mercado, supervisando el cumplimiento de los límites, políticas y disposiciones regulatorias aplicables, a fin de fortalecer la gestión de riesgos, el cumplimiento normativo y el logro de los objetivos estratégicos de la Sociedad. Ubicación: Oficinas Bradescard Guadalajara Horario: L-V 8:30am a 5:30pm Lo que harás: Coordinar la gestión integral de riesgos financieros, identificando, evaluando y revelando los riesgos a los que está expuesta la Sociedad. Monitorear y controlar los riesgos de crédito, liquidez y mercado, mediante la medición de exposiciones, seguimiento de límites, análisis de desviaciones y propuesta de acciones correctivas. Monitorear el cumplimiento de los límites de exposición al riesgo y de los niveles de tolerancia definicios en la Declaración de Apetito de Riesgo de la Sociedad, reportando excesos y proponiendo acciones correctivas. Dar seguimiento a la posición de liquidez, brechas de vencimiento y razones de cobertura, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requerimientos regulatorios aplicables. Monitorear y ejecutar los modelos de medición y análisis de riesgos financieros, incluyendo pruebas de estrés, análisis de sensibilidad, escenarios, backtesting y calibración de herramientas especializadas. Evaluar la suficiencia de capital y los requerimientos de capitalización, asegurando una gestión proactiva y el monitoreo oportuno de su evolución, así como la identificación temprana de posibles deterioros. Validar la integridad, confiabilidad y consistencia de la información utilizada en los procesos de medición y monitoreo de riesgos, asegurando su apego a las metodologías institucionales vigentes y el cumplimiento de la normativa aplicable. Evaluar el riesgo del portafolio crediticio y de contraparte, estimando las pérdidas esperadas, probabilidad de incumplimiento y severidad de la pérdida. Evaluar la exposición del portafolio de inversión de la tesorería mediante modelos de riesgos (VaR) para asegurar la correcta medición del riesgo de mercado, liquidez y contraparte de la Sociedad. Ejecutar revisiones y validaciones sobre el cálculo de reservas del portafolio crediticio para asegurar su correcta determinación y cumplimiento regulatorio. Contribuir al fortalecimiento continuo de la gestión integral de riesgos, mediante la actualización de metodologías, herramientas, indicadores y mejores prácticas alineadas con los objetivos estratégicos de la Sociedad. ¿Qué ofrecemos? - Modalidad de trabajo: Hibrida Salario competitivo.
